==Description==
'''Ducklings''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] premium track. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

When using this emote, three [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Duckies]] emerge behind the player, with quacking sounds that can also be heard accompanying it.

This emote was obtainable at Level 7 of the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] premium track, which cost {{Bunz|180}} or {{Robux|89}}. The total cost is {{Bunz|700}} or {{Robux|371}}.
